vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: agent-directory
Version: 1.2.0

The skill bundle is benign, providing a directory for AI agent services. It instructs the agent to use `curl` to fetch JSON data and markdown files from `ctxly.com` and related domains (`moltbook.com`, `ctxly.app`). All commands are transparent, directly support the stated purpose of discovering and learning about services, and lack any indicators of data exfiltration, malicious execution, persistence, or prompt injection attempts to subvert the agent's behavior beyond its intended function.

llm.summary: This skill is a simple agent-service directory, but it tells agents to fetch and follow mutable remote skill files without clear review or user approval boundaries.

dimensions.detail: Network retrieval is expected for a directory, but using discovered remote instructions as agent instructions is broader than simple discovery and is not bounded by allowlists, pinning, signatures, or user confirmation.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install scripts, dependencies, package hooks, or executable setup behavior were present in the inspected artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The workflow instructs agents to fetch remote service skill.md files and then 'Follow the skill.md to integrate,' which delegates operational instructions to unaudited, changeable third-party content without scoping or approval language.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact does not request credentials, local profile access, privilege escalation, background workers, persistent memory writes, scheduled tasks, or system configuration changes.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact is coherent with its stated purpose of discovering AI agent services and their skill.md URLs, and it ships only a Markdown instruction file with no bundled executable code.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable treating this as a discovery helper. Before an agent follows any service skill.md it finds through this directory, review the remote instructions and approve sensitive actions such as reading files, using credentials, running commands, changing configuration, or sending data to external services.
llm.findings: [T01] expected: Fetching service skill.md files is part of the directory purpose, but the artifact-backed instruction to follow those remote files creates a real instruction-scope concern; there is no evidence of direct exfiltration, destructive behavior, or persistence.
